about.name: Shanaaz Ahamed
about.title: Software Engineer
about.description: Software Engineer specializing in backend systems and cloud infrastructure. Currently working as a Software Engineer on VIDA4, a large-scale Health Information System (HIS) deployed across Saudi Arabia and the Middle East, automating release pipelines and hardening Keycloak IAM solution. Pursuing an MSc in Computer Science (Cloud Computing) at the University of Moratuwa, researching non-disruptive autoscaling for stateful Kubernetes workloads.

descriptions: Automated the release process for VIDA4, a Health Information System (HIS) used across Saudi Arabia and the Middle East, using Kubernetes, Python and Liquibase to eliminate manual deployment steps and accelerate environment setups.
Revamped the IAM solution by customizing Keycloak: built custom UI and SPIs to decouple modifications from the core codebase for maintainable future upgrades (Java, React).
Built full-stack features for the Finance and Administration modules of the VIDA4 platform using Spring Boot and Angular.
Built an MDT data processing and visualization web application (React, Python) with the Network Planning and Access Planning teams.
Developed an anomaly detection model using Facebook's Prophet library to flag anomalies in network data.

education.field: BSc (Hons) in Computer Science and Engineering

projects.title: Canny Edge Detection from Scratch
